subject: tablecodec: fix global index + commonHandle + restoredValues panic (#57104)
summary: Diff vs first parent only changes `pkg/tablecodec/tablecodec.go` to trim trailing negative-ID “extra columns” (e.g. `model.ExtraPhysTblID`) before restoring common-handle column bytes via `decodeRestoredValuesV5`, preventing a slice OOB panic when decoding clustered-index v1 + global index + commonHandle + restoredValues. ExtraPhysTblID is not part of the common handle and is expected to be last (caller-side convention), so this is correctness-only and semantics-neutral; no later upstream/master follow-up modifies this hunk.
